integrity: The proof is symbolic. It uses the published norm-theoretic characterization of locally finite tilability and independently checks preservation of (K)-polyhedrality, LFC, and norm equivalence under restriction. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is existential: it does not identify the new tiling with intersections of the original tiles, gives no shape or quantitative control, and does not address quotients or nonlinear subsets. The separable Banach special case is implicit in Fonf (1990); the claimed scope is arbitrary real normed spaces and arbitrary linear subspaces.
title: Locally finite tilings are hereditary to linear subspaces
